verdict.rationale: mParticle's integrations page and forwarding docs (data warehousing solutions, 'forward data to downstream services', connecting audiences to outputs via the integrations directory) imply it can push events/audiences to warehouse destinations, but the only detailed technical doc on warehouses (Warehouse Sync) actually describes the opposite flow — ingesting data FROM Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks INTO mParticle, not raw events landing in the customer's own warehouse on a schedule they control. There's no explicit evidence of a scheduled, engineer-controlled export/sync mechanism to Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or S3 for raw events and profiles. Missing for 10: documented outbound event/profile export connectors for each named warehouse/lake, explicit schedule/cadence controls, and confirmation that raw (not just aggregated/audience) data lands there.
